bugs.title: UserMenu shortcuts with intent (?modal=/?tab=) do nothing when already on the target route
bugs.rootCause: Pages read tab/modal intent only on mount (useModalFromQuery empty-deps useEffect + handled ref; admin ?tab= read once). UserMenu used plain <Link>, so a same-route click updated the URL but never remounted the page, so the mount-only reader never re-fired.
examples: Employer already on /employer/dashboard clicks UserMenu 'Quản lý ứng viên' (?modal=pending) → pending modal did not open
Worker already on /worker/dashboard clicks 'Điểm uy tín' (?modal=reputation) → reputation modal did not open
Admin already on /admin/dashboard clicks 'Tranh chấp' (?tab=disputes) → disputes tab did not switch
bugs.expected: Shortcut opens the intended tab/modal/section even when already on the target route, and again on repeat click, with no duplicate side effects.

fix.approach: Added navigateWithIntent() reusing the existing DASHBOARD_MODAL_EVENT; MenuLink dispatches it for same-route intents (preventDefault) and lets native <Link> handle cross-route.
fix.regressionTest: e2e/19-intent-deeplink.spec.ts (3 tests: employer pending modal, worker reputation modal, admin disputes tab; repeat-safe, no duplicate applications/disputes)
